findings.issue: הַשְּׂרָד (H8278) is its own singular noun, a different root from לְשָׁרֵת (H8334). «servicio» assigns that noun the serving sense of the following infinitive and leaves out the noun’s own sense.

notes: The rest of the verse matches the three object phrases, the articles, ל + infinitives, ב, Aarón, el sacerdote, and sus hijos.
